As an action, you can end your enhanced song in a triumphant final blast whose effect depends on which song you were playing. Once you've used this feature, you need a long rest before using it again.

Battle Crescendo. Choose up to 10 creatures you can see that can hear your song; each must succeed on a Constitution save or take 14d6 sonic damage and be stunned for 1d4+1 turns (half damage and no stun on a success). A creature slain by this effect has its head explode.

Support Crescendo. Choose up to 10 creatures you can see that can hear your song. Once within the next minute, each may, as a free action when it takes damage, halve that damage — and if the damage would drop it to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead.

Disruption Crescendo. Choose up to 10 creatures you can see that can hear your song; each must succeed on a Constitution save or be paralyzed for 1d4+1 turns, the effect ending for any creature that takes damage of any kind.
